question_text: Which areas of the venue had the most crowd activity? Rank them by their average crowd size.
answer_text: The areas of the venue ranked by their average crowd size are as follows: KeynoteHall_Stage with an average crowd size of 57.40, ExpoFloor_MainAisle with 49.36, FoodCourt_North with 23.07, DemoBooth_NVIDIA with 15.52, and DemoBooth_Intel with 10.65.

citations.cypher:
MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)-[:AT_CAMERA]->(c:Camera)-[:LOCATED_AT]->(l:Location)
WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
RETURN l.name AS location, AVG(ch.avg_hc) AS average_crowd_size
ORDER BY average_crowd_size DESC
